bio.text: Nick Begich is a member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Alaska; he was born in Anchorage and lives in Chugiak.
He holds a Bachelor of Business Administration in Entrepreneurship from Baylor University and an MBA from Indiana University.

He worked for Ford Motor Company, returned to Alaska in 2004, and started several businesses, and he has also worked with the Alaska Policy Forum and Club for Growth and served as a board director of Matanuska Telecom Association.
